state_protocol: prepare(context, request) applies the source numerical policy (train.py policy(), train.py:20-26), reads every dimension and count from request['workload'], builds GPT2LMHeadModel from workload['model'] under torch.manual_seed(workload['seed']) on context['device'], applies bottom-up fully_shard to each transformer block then the root, creates SGD (lr from workload, momentum 0., weight_decay 0., foreach=False), generates this rank's input tokens from a CPU generator seeded seed+100+rank, snapshots initial local parameter shards on CPU, and creates the retained CUDA quality-pass scalar torch.tensor(1) aggregated with dist.all_reduce MIN mirroring train.py:164; all of this lives in the returned state dict outside timing, and the worker's already-initialized process group is used (never re-initialized). reset(state) copies the initial CPU snapshots back into the local parameter shards and calls optimizer.zero_grad(set_to_none=True) outside the timer (train.py reset(), train.py:58-63), mirroring the source's setup/timed division where zero_grad is repeated inside the step. before_run(state) performs the source's control coordination dist.barrier() plus torch.cuda.synchronize() (train.py:141) outside the timer. run(state) executes the frozen step with phase annotations and returns detached loss/logits, which stay alive through native memory sampling; the quality-pass scalar is owned by state for the module lifetime and never explicitly deleted, releasing only at state teardown like the source's main() local. observe(state, result) returns CPU copies of loss, the complete logits, every local gradient shard and every post-update local parameter shard plus the tied-embedding boolean for framework-side reference comparison. metrics(state, result, elapsed_ms) reads native torch.cuda.max_memory_allocated/memory_allocated on state's device outside the timer and derives step_ms and global throughput from the unchanged work amount. models(state) exposes {'model': sharded root model} for discovery and controlled replacement.
